summary: spec.yaml's auth block must enumerate at least one real cookie name in auth.cookies for type: cookie; the generated client's own requiredAuthCookies() may stay intentionally empty (whole-domain-jar forwarding) since this field feeds spec validation, not runtime cookie selection.
reason: A newer cli-printing-press validator (present by v4.30.1, not enforced at this CLI's base_printing_press_version 4.28.0) hard-fails dogfood/verify/scorecard with 'auth.type is "cookie" but auth.cookies is empty; the generated client would never send cookies' whenever auth.cookies is empty for type: cookie, with no exemption for whole-jar-forwarding designs. Confirmed via internal/spec/spec.go's validateAuthConfig: the only exemption path (isHeaderCarriedCookieAuth) is for a distinct header-carried-credential pattern that doesn't apply here. Added the real app session cookie name (_easyorder_session, Rails-style naming, confirmed present via a live Chrome cookie-jar read against forkable.com — name only, no value inspected) rather than a placeholder.
validated_outcome: dogfood/verify/scorecard --spec spec.yaml parse the spec successfully post-fix; auth login --chrome and live API calls (doctor, account --json) continue to work unchanged since the Go client's cookie forwarding is untouched.
